Roof Plumbing & Re-Roofing in Arthurs Seat

Sandhurst Roofing is a family owned roofing business with more than 30 years of experience looking after homes right across Arthurs Seat. From re-roofs in COLORBOND® steel and roof plumbing to guttering and tile to tin conversions, we back every job with honest advice and quality workmanship.

Larger blocks, sheds and treed sites are part of the job in Arthurs Seat, and we are used to roofs that need more than a quick once-over. Call Steve on 0448 812 800 for a free, no-obligation quote.

Get a Free Quote!

Roofs in Arthurs Seat: What We Commonly See

Arthurs Seat rises above the bay as the highest hill on the Port Phillip side of the Peninsula, with leafy, elevated blocks running up the slopes above Dromana and Safety Beach. Homes here are often larger, set among tall gums on steep sites, many built to capture the bay views. Up on the hill the roofs deal with heavy gum-leaf and bark litter, moss and lichen on shaded southern slopes, and strong wind across the ridge that drives rain against flashings and lifts loose capping.

The jobs we are called out for most in Arthurs Seat are clearing and replacing leaf-choked gutters and valleys, refixing wind-lifted ridge capping, and re-roofing larger home roofs on steep, treed blocks.

Re-Roofing & Roof Replacement in Arthurs Seat

On larger blocks a roof is a bigger investment, and replacing one properly pays off for decades. We re-roof Arthurs Seat homes, sheds and outbuildings in COLORBOND® steel, which is light, strong and low maintenance, and handles heat, wind and heavy leaf litter well.

Thinking about going metal? We also handle tile to tin conversions, swapping a heavy, high-maintenance roof for lightweight metal. If your roof has widespread leaks, sagging or badly rusted sheeting, talk to us about a re-roof before you keep paying for patch jobs. We will give you a straight answer on what makes the most sense for your home and budget.

Roof Plumbing & Guttering in Arthurs Seat

Larger roofs and treed blocks put a lot of water and debris through the gutters. Our registered roof plumbers handle flashings, valleys, ridge capping, box gutters and downpipes, and can connect rainwater tanks and stormwater so the water ends up where it should.

We replace guttering, downpipes and fascia capping in COLORBOND® steel, from a single damaged section through to a complete gutter replacement, and we carry out gutter repairs where a repair is all that is needed. We remove the old guttering cleanly and leave the site tidy.

What Affects the Cost of Roofing in Arthurs Seat

Every roof is different, so we quote on what is actually in front of us rather than a one-size-fits-all price. The main things that move the cost are the size and pitch of the roof, the roofing material you choose, how much guttering and flashing is involved, and how easy the roof is to access safely. We will walk you through exactly what your quote covers so there are no surprises.

Our Arthurs Seat Roofing Process

We start with a free on-site inspection and a written quote. For a re-roof we strip the old roof, prepare the framing, fit insulation and sarking where needed, then re-sheet in new COLORBOND® steel with fresh flashings, ridge capping, gutters and downpipes. We leave the site clean and tidy when we are done.

Why Arthurs Seat Locals Choose Sandhurst Roofing

We are fully licensed and insured, with registered roof plumbers on the team, so your job is done to standard and you are covered. As a local, family run business we treat your home the way we would treat our own, turn up when we say we will, and give honest advice rather than a hard sell. Arthurs Seat Roofing FAQs

Do you work on sheds and outbuildings as well as the house?

Yes. We re-sheet and re-roof sheds, garages, stables and other outbuildings in metal, as well as the main house.

Can you fix gutters that fill with leaves and bark?

Yes. We replace overflowing gutters and valleys, and can fit systems that cope better with heavy leaf litter on treed blocks.

Do you offer free quotes?

Yes, every quote is free and without obligation. Call Steve on 0448 812 800.
